articles.title: Strategy holds STRC dividend at 11.5% for fourth straight month
articles.snippet: The preferred stock remains near its $100 par value as the company balances yield stability, ATM issuance capacity, and its bitcoin acquisition strategy.

articles.title: Bitcoin volatility is down 56% but analysts still expect up to 20% BTC price move
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s sharp volatility decline coincides with a 114-day trading range, setting the stage for a potential 10% to 20% price move, but the direction remains uncertain.

articles.title: Bitcoin preps 3% May downside, but US PMI data may boost BTC price
articles.snippet: Bitcoin faced ending May lower by around 3%, with the possibility of US PMI data giving BTC price action a boost next week.

articles.title: Florida Sues OpenAI, Sam Altman Over ChatGPT Safety Claims
articles.snippet: Florida's attorney general seeks damages, restrictions on ChatGPT, and personal liability for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in what the state describes as the first state-led lawsuit against the AI company.

articles.title: Binance Opens Access to 7,000 US Stocks, Prepares Tokenized 'bStocks' Rollout
articles.snippet: Binance opened equities trading and previewed "bStocks," with experts split over whether tokenization unlocks growth or layers on new risk.
